about.heading: Welcome to LOGICUS — A Company That Listens
about.text: Logicus Informatique specializes in custom software development. Our solutions are developed with WinDev, WebDev and WinDev Mobile, development tools recognized for their power and reliability. We offer scalable software solutions, tailored to your needs and proven since 1996.

items.title: Needs Analysis
items.text: We take the time to fully understand your needs in order to propose the most suitable solution. Analysis is a crucial step that ensures the success of your project.

items.title: Development
items.text: Our experienced programmers develop robust and high-performance solutions with WinDev, WebDev and WinDev Mobile. Quality code, tested and documented.

items.title: Implementation
items.text: We ensure a complete implementation of your software, including installation, configuration, data migration and production deployment.

items.title: Maintenance
items.text: We offer ongoing maintenance services to ensure the proper functioning of your applications and to evolve them according to your changing needs.

items.title: Training & Support
items.text: We offer personalized training for your teams as well as responsive technical support to answer all your questions.

items.title: Hosting
items.text: We offer reliable and secure hosting solutions for your applications and data. High-performance servers and regular backups.
